records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Truckload services revenues, excluding fuel surcharges, represented 66.4% and 75.5% of total revenues, excluding fuel surcharges, for the three months ended September 30, 2021 and 2020, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: For both operations, substantially all of our revenue is generated by transporting freight for customers and is predominantly affected by the rates per mile received from our customers, equipment utilization, and our percentage of non-compensated miles.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The truckload services division operating ratio, which measures the ratio of operating expenses, net of fuel surcharges, to operating revenues, before fuel surcharges, improved from 89.7% for the third quarter of 2020 to 77.9% for the third quarter of 2021.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Operating supplies and expenses decreased from 10.5% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the third quarter of 2020 to 8.0% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the third quarter of 2021.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Non-operating income (expense) increased from expense of 2.2% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the first nine months of 2020 to income of 1.9% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the first nine months of 2021.
